pf.services.capacity: One estimator or advisor per booking; one chimney or wall job at a time per crew; the showroom's design table is saved with long sessions

stop.says: Keep everyone away from that side, and call 911 if anyone is at risk.

pf.visit.check_in: Estimate visit: the check-in code at the door. Each work day: that day's code, or the lockbox and a start photo when nobody is home. Showroom: the code at the desk.
pf.visit.at_the_visit: The estimator measures, photographs and checks the mortar and the chimney from a ladder; the written quote follows within 3 business days, good for 30 days

pf.visit.outside_checks: A check of the flue and the rough work, and a final check, where the permit requires them
pf.visit.done: The final check where needed, then the walk-through and punch list, then DONE on the last work day; the care notes go with it
pf.visit.studio_done: DONE after the consult, with the stone advisor's notes and the picks saved for the estimate
pf.visit.before_photos: The wall or chimney, cracks, loose bricks, and anything nearby that could be hit (windows, gutters, plants)

pf.money.estimate: The example's $89 estimate visit is credited to the job; billed only if no contract follows. A free estimate is the safe start.
pf.money.no_money_before_contract: On project work, nothing is taken before the contract is signed by everyone on the deed
pf.money.deposit: Only after signing; the deposit cap comes from the state's form
pf.money.kept_apart: Money paid before the work is kept apart or bonded where the state's rules require it (a switch from the state's form)
pf.money.stages: Each stage is billed only when it's done and any check has passed: the start, the rebuild up to the roofline, the finish. Never ahead of the work
pf.money.last_payment: After the walk-through and the final check
pf.money.change_orders: Added to the next stage bill
pf.money.big_bills: Bank transfer through the company's own Stripe, for bills over the owner's amount (the example: $500); paid once it clears. A check also works: the lead mason texts 'paid check'.
pf.money.tax: Tax on materials and labor follows the state's form
pf.money.studio: The wall mock-up session's $55 is credited to the job if Alex signs; the $20 missed-consult fee only after Sam OKs it

never_in_texts: Contract, change order and permit papers (secure page only, with a copy by email)
pf.messages.minors: Never booked by a minor; a child at home is never the one who lets the crew in

pf.staff.roles: Lead masons (Gus, Tobias): estimates, quotes and running the job, with the crew. Stone advisors (Petra, Pavel) at the showroom.
pf.staff.licenses: The company holds the contractor registration or license. Where the state's form also licenses each person, each one may add a number (optional, shown as given, not checked by Rosie). Subcontractors hold their own, as the business says.
pf.staff.lead_safe: A certified renovator on each job in an older home, where lead-safe rules apply
pf.staff.who_oks: Sam OKs quotes and change orders over $500; Pat may OK them too, and Sam's answer wins
pf.staff.stand_in: Another lead mason may take an estimate visit; a job keeps its lead mason unless Sam moves it

pf.rules.contract: A written contract for project work where the state's rules require one, signed by everyone on the deed and by the business before any money
pf.rules.contract_parts: The parts the state's form lists (license number, dates, price, deposit, cancel notice, any lien notice)
pf.rules.cancel_window: A cancel window after signing, where the state's rules give one; work and orders wait for it
pf.rules.permits: Pulled by the license holder in the business's name, never the homeowner's
pf.rules.change_orders: Written and signed by both before the changed work
pf.rules.final: The final check and any permit sign-off before the last payment
pf.rules.lien_waivers: Lien waivers from the business and its subcontractors with the last payment, where the state's rules provide them
pf.rules.show: The license number on the listing, the quote, the contract and the receipt, where the state's rules require it
pf.rules.warranty: 1 year on workmanship (the example's). Hairline mortar cracks from normal settling are not a defect; the contract says what is covered.

pf.edges.weather: Rain or frost on a mortar day: the work moves, with no fee; the lead mason checks the forecast the day before
pf.edges.materials_late: The brick or stone lot is late: wait, or switch to an in-stock one
pf.edges.color_match: New brick and mortar never match old exactly; the quote says so and a sample is shown first
pf.edges.hidden_conditions: A cracked flue liner, rotted framing or loose footing found at tear-down: a change order before the fix
pf.edges.asbestos_found: Licensed removal first, by its own quote; the start moves, and Alex is told
pf.edges.permit_late: The start moves with no fee; Alex is told
pf.edges.inspection_fails: The crew fixes it and it's checked again; the next stage and its bill wait
pf.edges.high_work: Work above the first floor needs a scaffold or a lift; roofing work goes to a licensed roofer
pf.edges.cancel_after_window: Sam and the customer settle it; Rosie moves no money on its own
pf.edges.nobody_home: Estimates and sealing with the gate open, with start and end photos
pf.edges.over_license_limit: Not offered, and the owner is told why
pf.edges.walk_through_dispute: Goes to Sam; the last bill waits
pf.edges.other: All other edge cases are handled the generic way

notes:
Started from contractor (pattern: project): an estimate visit, a written quote, then a contract and stage bills. Facts, switches, settings and money paths are the parent's, re-worded for this work: documents, stages, photos, extrawork, firststeps, multiday, banktransfer; switch cancelright in flow B only (work sold at the customer's place); arrive A a set start, B a 2-hour window; cutoff 24 hours before.
Flow B main path visit|none|bill: the booking is the $89 estimate visit, credited to the job; Gus's written quote; the contract signed by everyone on the deed; $1,200 to start, $7,200 when the new chimney is built to the roofline, $3,600 at the finish (a $12,000 chimney rebuild). The $89 keeps the master's numbers true; a free estimate is the owner's choice (pf.money).
B money paths: visit|none|bill, visit|none|own, visit|card|bill, photos|deposit|bill (Brick step repair, $640 from photos, a $160 deposit). Left out: list paths. Chimney cap install ($179) and Brick sealing ($150) are in pf.services, but the master's booking cards name one list service, so a list path would show the wrong name (MASTER).
Flow A is Sam's second company, Lee Stone Studio, a stone showroom (the master's Lee's Barbershop). Main path list|card|counter: a $35 stone consult with Petra, a card saved for the $20 missed-consult fee, paid at the showroom desk. The other three: list|none|counter, list|full|none (wall mock-up session, $55, credited to the job if Alex signs), list|deposit|counter (fireplace and chimney design package, $140, $40 deposit).
Flow A has no video or phone consult: the stone consult uses the sample walls and boards at the showroom (the A4-01 video branch is hidden because the fact `video` is not listed).
Own steps: A8-x01 (the stone consult offers the estimate visit at home), B8-x06 to B8-x08 (the permit and a test of the old mortar go first; a late permit moves the start with no fee; asbestos found in the old flue lining means a licensed removal first, by its own quote) and B8-x11 / B8-x12 (a cracked flue liner found inside the old chimney: a change order first, signed by both).
Masonry is work at height on old buildings: the questions ask the year the home was built and how high the work is (pf.questions), older homes get lead-safe and asbestos care as first steps where the rules require them (pf.first_steps), the scaffold is booked once the cancel window ends, and roofing goes to a licensed roofer (pf.edges high_work).
Booking choices: B timing settime, times window; A times setstart. Nothing is sent now (S2-30 'Yes' branch off, no `sentnow` fact), so nobody is on call.
Plug-in splits kept whole (splitsKept): A7-15; B5-34, B7-55, B8-58, B8-69 (as the parent).
Names: Gus and Tobias are the crew leads (the master's Jordan and Casey), Petra and Pavel the stone advisors (Riley and Avery). None of them is a master customer's name. Addresses: 415 Kiln Rd (the company), 74 Hill St (the showroom), 9 Linden Way (Alex). License numbers use an obviously fake format (MS-00123, CH-00456, SY-00789).
Every state rule is a switch from the state's form: the license and its job-size limit, the written contract and its parts, the deposit cap, money kept apart, the cancel window, permits, lien waivers, what must be shown. No state, city or number from one.
keep: color (a real word of this work), the estimate visit (the trade's own word), leak and valve (the master's safety examples), roofing (the work it doesn't do).
Rename: the contractor's pairs re-worded for this work (master sentences first, then phrases, then single words); 'cut' and 'hair' words that the master uses for its barbershop are turned into this work's words or removed (S1-38, S1-60, S13-55, B8-34).
